name: Free Lunch Lab basic income cost by country
description: Population (total, children and adults), GDP in local currency and US dollars, central government expense, revenue and tax revenue as a share of GDP, and the monthly amount and yearly cost (as a share of GDP) of paying everyone the World Bank international poverty line of $3.00 a day, for every country and territory in the Free Lunch Lab basic income cost calculator. World Bank data (CC BY 4.0) for most countries; official national figures for the seven featured countries.
license: CC BY 4.0 (World Bank data: CC BY 4.0, https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses#cc-by)

methods.worldBank: World Bank API (api.worldbank.org/v2), retrieved 2026-11-09; latest non-empty year per indicator since 2015. Children = under 18: the sum of single-year age populations 0 to 17, female and male (SP.POP.AG00.FE.IN ... SP.POP.AG17.MA.IN, based on UN World Population Prospects), for the same year as total population. Adults (18+) = total population minus children. Government expense, revenue (excluding grants) and tax revenue as % of GDP (GC.XPN.TOTL.GD.ZS, GC.REV.XGRT.GD.ZS, GC.TAX.TOTL.GD.ZS), central government, latest year; the LCU amount for that year is kept for reference. null when the World Bank has no value since 2015. The calculator compares with government figures only when they are no more than 5 years older than the GDP year (governmentUsedInCalculator).
methods.featured: For the seven featured countries (jp, us, cn, in, es, de, eg) population and GDP are the figures used in the calculator (official national statistics or UN WPP and World Bank, see sources); Japan also has its national budget.
methods.povertyLine: povertyLine.monthly = US$3.00 a day (World Bank international poverty line, 2021 PPP, June 2025 update) x 365/12, converted into local currency with the World Bank PPP conversion factor for household consumption (PA.NUS.PRVT.PP) when it is from the GDP year or the year before and implies a price level between 0.1 and 2.5 times the exchange rate; otherwise with the exchange rate implied by GDP in local currency / GDP in US dollars (same year). Rounded to two significant figures.
methods.defaultMonthly: The calculator default: povertyLine.monthly for World Bank countries; a round figure chosen by the editors for the seven featured countries.
methods.cost: costAtPovertyLine.yearly = population x povertyLine.monthly x 12 (gross, local currency); pctGdp = yearly / GDP.
dropped: KP Korea, Dem. People's Rep. (no GDP)
